method.boxes: median and central 50% of comparable SKU observations; whiskers=min/max; no box if n<3; NOT confidence intervals
method.families: comparison_analysis.family; within each family and orientation take median; families with both orientations contribute once
method.test: two-sided exact sign test of matched-family ratio relative to 1; ties omitted; exploratory independence/equal-sign-probability assumptions, not causal or market-population inference
method.multiplicity: Holm correction across all nonempty sign tests for the 7 listed metrics and 3 orientation pairs
method.local_total: maximum-capacity local_work layer per product times its documented physical instance count; NOT total SRAM or shared capacity
